title: One On One
description:
S1 E15 — Adventures In Double Dating
Flex butts into Breanna’s dating life.

title: One On One
description:
S1 E16 — Me And My Shadow
Opportunity knocks when Flex reunited with his high-school music group and Breanna winds up as cheerleading captain.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E1 — The Presentation
Mark is hired as a substitute teacher, but his roommate Robin must teach him how to control his students. Alan Thicke guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E2 — Hangin' With Michelle
Mark injures himself while performing a story for his substitute first-grade class, including Michelle Tanner (MARY KATE/ASHLEY OLSEN). Afterward, Mark is too embarrassed to keep his date with a beautiful woman (GALYN GORG).

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E3 — On The Rebound
Mark's ex-girlfriend, Paula (LELA ROCHON), moves back into town and revives their passionate romance.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E4 — Please Pass the Jock
Mark helps a student basketball player (CHRISTOPHER CARTER) pass an important algebra test. Chris Tucker guest stars.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E5 — Cheers
When Mark coaches a girls' cheerleading team, he desperately asks Vanessa to help him train the untalented cheerleaders.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E6 — Warriors, Part I
After Mark finally gets a permanent teaching job as a basketball coach, he's offered a contract to play for the Warriors, a professional basketball team. First of a two-part episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E7 — Warriors, Part II
Mark is given a temporary contract to play professional basketball with his favorite team, the Warriors. Unfortunately, Mark must play guard against basketball star Charles Barkley (HIMSELF). Second of a two-part episode.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S1 E8 — Torn Between Two Teachers
Mark and Robin try to make Andre choose between his interests in basketball and music.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E4 — Hakeem Owes Moesha Big
Moesha and her father coach Hakeem on how to get a job.  As a result, the owner of a sporting goods store (Bo Jackson) hires him.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E5 — Million Boy March
Moesha and Kim attend a church youth group designed to build leadership, but they experience resistance from the leader of the event because they are female.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E6 — Driving Miss Moesha
Moesha gets her driver’s license but refuses Frank’s gift of a Saturn, preferring to earn her own money for her dream car -- a new Jeep.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E7 — Chain, Chain, Chain
A chain letter stirs up trouble and causes havoc with Moesha’s family and friends.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E13 — Everybody Hates Minimum Wage
When Doc refuses to give Chris a raise, Chris goes out and gets a new job at the local Chinese restaurant.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E14 — Everybody Hates Gretzky
In an attempt to keep his younger brother, Drew, out of further trouble, Chris reluctantly agrees to skip school and accompany Drew on a mission to find his idol, hockey great Wayne Gretzky.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E15 — Everybody Hates The BFD
Chris is so desperate to raise the funds to go to a Run DMC concert that he jumps at the chance to participate in Mr. Omar's Black Funeral Directors' (BFD) scholarship fund.

title: Everybody Hates Chris
description:
S3 E16 — Everybody Hates Being Cool
On a mission to become one of the 'cool' kids, Chris is caught with cigarettes and suspended from school.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E12 — The Big Turning Over A New Leaf Episode
While throwing a baby shower for her ex-boyfriend and his new wife, Dee Dee notices that everyone is paired up except for her, and begins to struggle with her nonexistent personal life.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E13 — The Big Diva Down Episode
Mona & Spencer become at odds over giving their newest act the 'star treatment' during a music video shoot. Meanwhile, Dee Dee is asked to appear on a popular sports program that wants to feature female sports agents.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E14 — The Big My Funny Valentine Episode
Mona becomes worried when her new boyfriend, Chase, seems to have no special plans for their first Valentine's Day together. Dee tries to cheer up Brett when she discovers he broke up with his ex-fiancé a year ago on Valentine’s Day.

title: Half & Half
description:
S4 E15 — The Big Take Me As I Am Episode
After finding out that her rival, Naomi Dawson is giving Spencer the cold shoulder, Mona immediately confronts her, and Naomi reveals to Spencer that she is HIV positive.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E11 — Santa's Got a Brand New Bag
Mark and Geneva are saddened when Nicole stops believing in Santa. Then a mysterious cousin visits, who knows how to make Nicole happy.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E12 — Private School
Mark is assigned to teach Black history at an expensive private school for one week. When the principal offers him a job at a much higher salary, Mark has a big decision to make.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E13 — For Whom the Heck the Bell Tolls
Not wanting to admit that he can't remember a recently deceased basketball coach, Mark agrees to give the eulogy at his funeral.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E14 — It's My Party and I'll Die If I Want to
It is almost Mark's 30th birthday, and Tyler discovers a lump on Mark. After a misunderstanding with his doctor, Mark thinks that he is dying so he goes skydiving and gives away his stuff.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E15 — The Courtship of Mark Cooper
Mark is in the midst of defending himself in court when he realizes the plaintiff's lawyer is an ex-girlfriend he dumped brutally.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E16 — Wedding Bell Blues
When Mark's demanding employer, P.J., tells him she is going to marry her old boyfriend and quit her job, Mark has to decide if he should tell her a secret that could make her cancel the wedding. Queen Latifah guest stars and sings "Just Another Day.".

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E17 — Truth or Consequences
Mark and Vanessa make a bet on who can go the longest without telling a lie.

title: Hangin' With Mr. Cooper
description:
S2 E18 — Trading Places
When Vanessa applies for a job at a conservative Christian radio station, she tells the manager that Mark is her husband and Geneva is her wild cousin.

title: The Parkers
description:
S4 E20 — Join the Club
Nikki joins a snobby book club.

title: The Parkers
description:
S4 E21 — Internship
Kim and her rival compete for a fashion job.

title: The Parkers
description:
S4 E22 — She’s a Bad Mamma Jamma
A little boy plays Cupid for his dad and Nikki.
